product.title: Millionaire's Row Cruise
product.description: Sail through Biscayne Bay on a narrated bilingual sightseeing cruise showcasing the Miami skyline, Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and celebrity estates along Millionaire's Row. This approximately 1 hour 30 minute cruise includes a comfortable vessel setup with an air-conditioned interior lounge, onboard restroom, and premium cash bar service.
highlights: Narrated bilingual Biscayne Bay sightseeing cruise
Views of the Miami skyline, Port of Miami, Fisher Island, Biscayne Bay, and Millionaire's Row homes
Air-conditioned interior seating and onboard restroom

itineraryItems.description: Depart from Bayside Marketplace for a narrated sightseeing route on Biscayne Bay.

faqs.question: How long is the Millionaire's Row Cruise?
faqs.answer: The sightseeing cruise lasts approximately 1 hour 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point?
faqs.answer: Board at Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132, USA.

faqs.question: What will we see on the cruise?
faqs.answer: The route features Biscayne Bay views including the Miami skyline, Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and Millionaire's Row homes.

faqs.question: Is narration available in more than one language?
faqs.answer: Yes, this cruise includes bilingual narration.

faqs.question: Are there onboard amenities?
faqs.answer: The vessel includes an air-conditioned room, restroom, and a premium cash bar.

additionalInfo: Boarding opens before departure time; arrive early with your mobile or printed confirmation.
Redemption is completed at check-in before boarding at Bayside Marketplace.
